notes: All 28 projects of the 2025A edition are recorded (24 asking a B.Sc., 4 asking an M.Sc. or M.Sc./PhD), as in the earlier pass; Annex III and Annex IV agree on the project set. Added for searchability: the 7 research fields, and the degree disciplines each project names as its entry requirement (27 at bachelor's level, 10 at master's level), each marked as such in the detail.

Project 03 is listed by Annex IV as B.Sc. or M.Sc. and by Annex III as M.Sc.; it is kept at master's level. Projects 14 and 15 accept M.Sc. or PhD holders; kept at master's level. Project 02 has a different title in Annex III (human body activity in stress conditions) and Annex IV (human emotional response to a visual stimulus).
Recorded: bachelor's rows 24 projects + 7 fields + 27 disciplines; master's rows 4 projects + 10 disciplines. The 2025 edition is closed; no later edition was on the programme page on 2026-11-14.
not_stated: Majors as university degree programmes: the fellowship is individual research at AGH, not a degree programme.
